         **Review examples:**

            3. _Ryan Humphryes 97_, Aug 1, 2026, 2/5: "So many in app bugs - bikes not starting, no ability to end ride, would be amazing if there was actual functionality. GPS is also inaccurate by approx 10-15metres which means it’s impossible cycling to work in Oxford Circus because it says where 50+ bikes are parked is a no park zone - you have to run basically only the road of regent st for the GPS to say you can park, and then run back and take a photo!"
